  "summary": "This four-page archival bundle records the Swatantra Party National Executive meeting held at Woodlands Hotel, Mylapore, Madras, on 17 April 1977, with G.K. Sundaram presiding. The minutes describe members’ experience of offering cooperation to Janata Party candidates during the recent general election and consider whether the Swatantra Party should merge with Janata. They note that Janata had become the principal democratic opposition alternative to Congress and record two proposals: an outright merger or the continuation of Swatantra’s ideological work through a Rajaji Trust.\n\nThe adopted resolutions mourn the death of President Fakruddin Ali Ahmed, call for a nationwide celebration of C. Rajagopalachari’s birth centenary in December 1978, establish the Rajaji Trust, and approve immediate merger with Janata. The minutes also congratulate the electorate for defeating the Congress government, condemn the Emergency-era suspension of fundamental rights and press freedom, and welcome Jayaprakash Narayan’s leadership and Morarji Desai’s government. The accompanying circular from Joint Secretary V.S. Srikumar urges politically active Swatantra workers to join Janata while supporting Rajaji’s ideas through the proposed Trust, study circles, and forums. The final page is an envelope addressed to Minoo Masani.",
